data.name: Mahebub
data.gender_notes: Mahebub is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahebub is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘māheshvara’, which means ‘the god of intoxication’. Mahebub is a name of Lord Shiva, who is also known as the god of wine and is often depicted holding a drink or a cup of wine in his hand. The name Mahebub carries the meaning “God of Wine” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahebub usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of intoxication and the loss of self-consciousness, leading to a deeper connection with the divine.
